name: Flashing indicator lamp
summary: A flashing indicator lamp provides a documented intermittent visual indication.
description: A flashing indicator lamp provides a documented intermittent visual indication. The flash-generation function may be internal or separately controlled and should be identified.
readingNotes: Trace whether the flashing signal originates in the lamp assembly or the controller.
